name: pl.brightinventions.slf4android.handler.notifydeveloper.NotifyDeveloperDialogDisplayActivity
description: Bright Inventions' SLF4Android Notify Developer handler opens this Activity to ask whether to email an error report with optional log attachments. Its prompt can be triggered by shaking the device.
disableEffect: The error report prompt may fail to open when the handler needs this screen, interrupting that reporting flow.
